sanskrit_verse:
भुक्तिस्त्रैपुरुषी यत्र चतुर्थे संप्रवर्तिता ।
तद्भोगः स्थिरतां याति न पृच्छेदागमां क्वचित् ॥
transliteration: bhuktis traipuruṣī yatra caturthe saṃpravartitā / tadbhogaḥ sthiratāṃ yāti na pṛcched āgamāṃ kvacit //
sph_interpretive_translation: Where enjoyment has been enjoyed by three generations and initiated in the fourth, that enjoyment becomes permanently established and requires no further validation from any source.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through continuity of conscious enjoyment
Causation is rooted in sustained experiential succession
Capacity-based responsibility emerges through generational engagement
Restoration occurs through recognition of already-established order
Consciousness alignment arises when lineage-based experience is honored
executable_legal_axioms: IF a practice or right has been continuously enjoyed by three successive generations AND initiated in the fourth, THEN it shall be deemed irrevocably established without external validation.
IF a claimant demonstrates unbroken lineage-based usage across three generations with initiation in the fourth, THEN automatic recognition of entitlement SHALL occur.
NO external testimony or documentation SHALL override sustained multi-generational experiential establishment.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating property rights, traditional customs, or hereditary privileges, if evidence shows continuous enjoyment across three generations with initiation in the fourth, courts must recognize such claims as inherently valid without requiring corroborative proof. This aligns judicial authority with the ontological reality of experientially-rooted dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This rule reflects pramāṇa-based causality where truth is derived from uninterrupted experiential succession (anupūrvaśaḥ). It establishes proportional responsibility not through punitive measures but through acknowledgment of what consciousness has already realized and stabilized. There is no imposition; only alignment with what is.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Confirm uninterrupted lineage-based enjoyment across four generations.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Recognize the inherent validity of established experiential succession.
Integrity Reintegration: Affirm societal harmony by validating ancestral patterns upheld through conscious repetition.
Capacity Restoration: Reinforce the capacity of lineage holders to maintain and transmit established truths.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Where enjoyment spans three generations and initiates the fourth, it stands firm in Dharma. No external validation supersedes this experiential truth. Justice is restoration, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates. Dharma is restored.
